material.question: Can the required five-critic rendered panels, pre-move records and saturation rounds be produced without the dada protocol the row names?
material.witness_evidence: expected: the five-critic panels, pre-move records and saturation rounds can be produced from the row's named protocol; observed: the named protocol is absent (u1 dispatch 1793543326232-467-a519c921b782929b; u2 none). Available Skill-list entries (graphic-design-adaptive-critics, graphic-design-ambition-workflow) are different skills and the row names only the located dada SKILL.md, so substituting one is not authorized. Result: no.
